deferred_findings.rationale: Attempted ktlint 12.1.2 and BACKED IT OUT. Default "official" ruleset produced 628 findings on this codebase: 247 multiline-expression-wrapping, 232 function-signature, 55 no-empty-first-line-in-class-body -- all pure style preference and no defects -- plus 29 function-naming flagging every @Composable for PascalCase, which is CORRECT Compose convention. Only 5 findings were real (2 unused imports, 3 import ordering). Disabling the offending rules via .editorconfig did not take effect with this plugin version, and the aggregate task failed while every source set reported NO-SOURCE, suggesting the plugin does not resolve Kotlin under src/main/java. A red build from a linter is worse than no linter, so it was reverted rather than left half-configured.
deferred_findings.next_attempt_should: Prefer Detekt: it targets code smells rather than formatting, so it will not fight Compose naming or produce hundreds of wrapping findings. If ktlint is retried, verify it resolves src/main/java sources first, and fix the 2 unused imports and 3 import-ordering findings by hand regardless -- those were genuine.
